item.title: Jupiter Lend Under Stress: Analyzing the October 10 Liquidation Event
item.description:
On October 10, 2025, U.S. President Donald Trump announced that the U.S. would impose an additional 100% tariff on Chinese imports. This announcement was followed by a rapid market selloff: over the course of October 10, the price of ETH fell as much as 12% and SOL fell as much as 24%.

The wave of selling ultimately triggered $19B in liquidations across derivative markets. But how did this affect other venues that offer leverage, like credit markets?

item.title: Building an Agentic Pipeline for Onchain Data Analysis
item.description:
Using an LLM for data analysis can sometimes create more problems than it solves. In a chat-based workflow, the analyst still has to supply table schemas, API documentation, and project-specific context while copying and pasting data between multiple interfaces and tools. If you’re not careful this setup can increase token costs and introduce errors – undermining the time saved by using an LLM in the first place.

At Blocmates, we created an agentic pipeline to automate these tasks. Instead of manually providing context and coordinating each step, the analyst starts by filling out a data specification and sends it to Claude Code. The agent loads the necessary context, writes SQL queries, fetches data from APIs, and tests and publishes the queries to Dune.

item.title: Building a Local AI System to Stay Ahead of the Crypto News Cycle
item.description:
With Crypto operating 24/7 it’s challenging to keep up with current news while also going deep on a report. Writing forces you to focus on a project or sector deeply, but you still have to track headlines that could change your thesis or reframe the data.

To solve this, I built an AI research assistant to keep me up to date with the latest news in crypto and finances everyday, in around 20 minutes reading time – down from 1-2 hours. It runs on locally hosted models including OpenAI’s GPT OSS 20b, and Deepseek R1 via LM studio.
